en: "{11:0001:0015} is a dangerous spell.{w}That's exactly why it demands understanding, too.{w}It'll probably be on the exam, so you'd better learn it, okay?"{w}
note: Spell name is a runtime insert (the top Mage attack spell per Kathleen's lecture, slice 054).

en: "Ahh, how is everyone doing~{w}Are you studying properly, hmmm~?"{w}{p}"Your time as a student seems long, but it's short, you knooow~{w}No rushing, no letting up, no slacking off, that's the way~{w}Snort-hee~"{w}
note: buhihi = 'snort-hee' as in slices 026/037; the musical note -> '~'.

en: "Hm? Aren't those certificates of completion?{w}Oh, so you've finally collected them all!{w}Well done, well done. Here now, please take this!"{w}
note: shuuryoushou = the per-year completion certificates (key items in slices 055/056).

en:
[Key Item]
You obtained the Diploma.{w}
note: New key item name: Diploma (sotsugyou shousho; Soara's 'my diploma' in slice 016). Align with the key-item table.

en: "You are the pride of our school~.{w}What you've learned will surely be of use to everyone in the land."{w}{p}"Even after you graduate, never lose the will to learn, and keep aiming higher~"{w}{p}"If things ever get hard, come and visit anytime.{w}Next time, I really will have Mont Blancs and such ready to welcome you~ Snort-hee-hee!!"{w}
note: kondo koso = 'next time, for sure' (implies the treat was missing before). Mont Blanc = the chestnut cake.

en: "Come and visit anytime.{w}You'll always be welcome, you knooow~ Snort-hee-hee!!"{w}

"Snort? The Board Chair's office?{w}The Board Chair isn't someone you can just go and see, you knooow~{w}What business might you have, hmmm~?"{w}{p}"I see, Soara has, has she~...{w}Even so, the Board Chair told me not to let anyone through~"{w}{p}"I'm sorry, but would you kindly take your leave~?{w}Snort-hee-hee!!"{w}
note: haa, Soara-san ga~ trails off: the party has explained that Soara is involved; kept as a trailing acknowledgement.

en: "...Oh my, oh my, you're serious, aren't you~"{w}

"I think your aspirations are wonderful~{w}I've heard the strange rumors about the Board Chair, too~"{w}{p}"But even so, I can't let you through here~{w}I owe the Board Chair for letting me serve as Principal~"{w}{p}"If you absolutely insist...{w}then I'll have to get rough~"{w}{p}"Bfuuu... You're prepared for that...?{w}I see. Then it can't be helped~{w}I'll just have to see you out with everything I've got! Snooort!!"{w}
note: 'You're prepared for that...?' answers an unvoiced reply from the party (kakugo no ue da to).

en: "Snoooooooort!?"{w}
You routed the Principal.{w}
"So sorry about thaaat~{w}Snort, snort-hee-hee..."{w}
"Mmpa-mmpa..."{w}
note: Mumbling while knocked out (npa npa); no meaning.

en: The Principal has been knocked flat.{w}He won't come to for a while.{w}
note: Principal is male (lead convention).

en: "Well, well, if it isn't everyone.{w}How are you doing? Snort-hee-hee!"{w}
You sense an immense magical power drawing near.{w}Space twists, and then...{w}
note: Subject restored: the party senses it.

en: "Oh, where's Soara? Am I a little early?{w}From this spot, I can send you to where the Board Chair is."{w}{p}"I'll send you on ahead, at least."{w}
note: kimitachi dake demo = 'you, at least / even if only you' (Soara is not here yet).

en: "Are you ready?"
"All right, here we go.{w}............Haaaaah!!"{w}
"I see. Let me know when you're ready."{w}

note: Banner in the source's asterisk frame (47 chars per line); centring to check in game.

en: In the middle of the strange room stood an elderly figure wearing a robe.{w}It was most likely the Board Chair.{w}
note: roujin = old person; the Board Chair's gender is not established (glossary), so 'elderly figure', no pronoun.

en: Board Chair

"So you've made it this far...{w}I know all about you."{w}{p}"Now then, wait a little.
It would be foolish to have the same conversation twice."{w}
note: The Chair is waiting for Soara (next rows).

en: The elder seemed not the least bit shaken at the sight of you.{w}The Chair stood perfectly still, as if waiting for something.{w}
note: Pronouns avoided for the Chair (gender unknown).

en:
After a while,
Soara threw the door open and burst in.{w}
"Board Chair!!"{w}
"So you've come, Soara. I've been waiting for you."{w}

"Board Chair...{w}I respect you, Board Chair!{w}And yet, why..."{w}{p}"You of all people should know how terrifying spells can be, even better than we do!"{w}{p}"Why would you go out of your way to create something as dangerous as an Ultimate Mana Source!!"{w}
note: New term: gokumagen = 'Ultimate Mana Source' (not in glossary; Kathleen's lecture in slice 054 also uses koumagen, suggested 'High Mana Source').

en: "Heh heh heh...{w}It seems having a junior who's a little too capable can be its own kind of trouble."{w}{p}"Since you know that much, I'll tell you.{w}You lot seem to have graduated from this school as well, so I suppose there's no harm in saying it."{w}{p}"You all believe that you are living on this land, don't you?{w}But that is not so."{w}{p}"You are... no, we are...{w}being kept alive.{w}Like livestock."{w}
note: kouhai = 'junior' (Soara, who is the Chair's younger self per slice 016). ikiteiru vs ikasareteiru = living vs being kept alive.

en: "Livestock...?{w}Isn't that going too far?"{w}

note: majutsu = 'Sorcery' (the Mage school, as opposed to priest prayer); riidingu = 'Reading', capitalised as a term. Self-correction 'power... no, world' kept, word order adjusted within the same page.

en: "I don't think that's true at all!{w}Look at Semnadoc! Isn't it thriving, blessed with so much of the god's love?"{w}
note: Semnadoc here = the holy city (prospering), blessed by the god of the same name.

en:
"Then who has seen this god?{w}Who has spoken with this god?{w}Who has heard from the god's own mouth that it cherishes us?"{w}{p}"Archbishop Mersenne is working very hard, you know.{w}In devotion to the god Semnadoc, there is likely no one on this land who can match him."{w}{p}"And yet,
Semnadoc does not speak a word even to him.{w}Why is that?"{w}
note: Mersenne is male (glossary evidence is this very line). Semnadoc's gender unknown: 'it' used for the god in the abstract question, no he/she. 'Archbishop' for daishikyou (not in glossary).

en:
"'The gods must surely love us.'{w}'The gods prepared the land for us.'{w}'The gods exist for our sake.'"{w}{p}"All of that is nothing more than our 'wishes' --
how we want the gods to be."{w}
note: kami read as plural 'the gods' following the Chair's kamigami.

en:
"Th... then,
what purpose are the gods preparing the land for...?"{w}
"Is it a living thing?"{w}
"I don't know."{w}
"Then, is it an object?"{w}
"No, that I don't know either."{w}
"I don't know what it is, but it seems they're waiting for it to appear."{w}

"Somehow...
that's awfully vague, coming from you, Board Chair."{w}
"It seems they haven't obtained any more information than that, either."{w}
note: karera = 'they' (Zoze, see next rows), not the gods.

en: "'They'? Who are 'they'?"{w}

"Zoze, a Kin of Darkness who answered my call."{w}{p}"Zoze has wandered through many scrapped lands,
and is now said to be in a land called
Belnaf Arana."{w}{p}"This land
can easily be scrapped on a single whim of the gods."{w}{p}"If so, then the way for us to survive
is to free this land from the gods' rule
and make it stand on its own."{w}{p}"To gain that power,
I made a... deal with Zoze."{w}
note: Zoze's gender unknown: name repeated, no pronoun. haiki = 'scrapped' (glossary notes).

en: "!! ...No... Board Chair..."{w}

"I want to bring true peace
to this land."{w}{p}"My deal with Zoze: information on the Ultimate Mana Source in exchange for safety.{w}When I make the Ultimate Mana Source appear in this room,
Zoze helps keep the land from collapsing."{w}{p}"Behold the barrier surrounding this room.{w}I made the barrier so powerful
that it warped space itself."{w}{p}"Even this is not enough,
but Zoze says the shortfall will be made up."{w}{p}"We will record how the Ultimate Mana Source forms and what results,
and use that to research new spells."{w}{p}"Judging from the way the gods forbid
the casting of {11:0001:0015} through the spirits,
the Ultimate Mana Source is likely a power that even the gods cannot handle."{w}{p}"We will obtain it, control it at will,
and hold power equal to the gods'.{w}That is our plan."{w}
note: yatsu (Zoze) rendered by name. Subject of 'forbid through the spirits' restored as the gods (Kathleen's lecture: gods direct the spirits). mote-amasu = more than one can handle.

en:
"Power... equal to the gods...!?{w}I don't believe we could ever
fully control power like that."{w}
"Ah, I won't ask you to understand.{w}But do not interfere. Is that clear?"{w}
"Now, it's nearly time for the Ultimate Mana Source experiment.{w}Leave this place."{w}

"No, Board Chair...{w}It's wrong, it really is!!{w}Even if what this Zoze says is true!"{w}{p}"Why does such a high-risk experiment
as making an Ultimate Mana Source emerge
have to be done on this land!?"{w}{p}"Did Zoze give you
an explanation that actually convinced you!?{w}Please, wake up, Board Chair!"{w}

What's the matter, Board Chair of Rubenburg?
Isn't it about time to carry out the Ultimate Mana Source experiment?{w}
note: Disembodied voice (??? box); source has no quote brackets, kept unquoted. Ruubenburugu rijichou read as 'Board Chair of Rubenburg' (school name).

en: "Nngh... So you've come..."{w}
Clinging Darkness
note: Glossary name, 17 chars: over the ~16-char name-box guide; check width.

en: "The time is ripE. Now, quickly, begin the experimenT."{w}
note: This tentacle voice ends words in stray katakana (mic-ta, jikken-wo); rendered by capitalising the last letter of the affected word. Same device in 4078, 4090, 4105.

en: "Heh heh heh... Quite so, quite so.{w}Dispose of that meddling little girl."{w}
note: kukuku + sayou, sayou = 'Heh heh heh... Quite so, quite so' (the second tentacle voice; also 4080, 4092, 4107).

en: "Sorry, but I have no taste for laying hands on my own students."{w}
"What did you say?{w}Do you mean to break your contract with us?"{w}
note: Third tentacle voice: refined, watakushi + desu wa.

en: "Now, now, don't be hasty, Zoze.{w}Soara, leave this barrier at once."{w}

"Hey, you, Zoze or whatever you are!{w}Have you properly thought about what happens
after the Ultimate Mana Source appears?"{w}
"Insolent little girl..."{w}
"We have thought of it. Rest easY."{w}
note: Distorted voice (see 4064).

en: "Heh heh heh... Quite so, quite so."{w}
"Then the Ultimate Mana Source...{w}what happens to it after it appears!!"{w}

"...Nothing of the sort you're worried about
will happen, I assure you."{w}
"Carry out the experiment and see it with your own eyes, why don't you."{w}
note: yokarou: fourth, archaic voice. Addressee left as 'you' (Soara and/or the Chair).

en:
"...Board Chair!{w}Are you really going to trust someone
who gives such evasive answers!?"{w}{p}"'Pile up unclear, vague things,
and you'll never get a correct result' --
those were your own words, Board Chair, weren't they!?"{w}
"Board Chair, this child is still younG.{w}She cannot keep up with our discussioN.{w}Move on to the next stage, quicklY."{w}
note: Distorted voice (see 4064). 'She' = Soara (female per glossary).

en: "Heh heh heh... Quite so, quite so.{w}Besides, my support will not last forever, you know."{w}
"What is it? Has something gone wrong?"{w}
note: The Chair asks Zoze; the reply (4096) says things will get troublesome.

en: "It looks like things will get troublesome if this drags on.{w}Would you be so kind as to hurry with the experiment?"{w}
"I see. Very well.{w}Soara, I will not kill you.{w}But I will not let you interfere, either..."{w}{p}"Watch my arcane experiment from a front-row seat!!"{w}
note: juma jikken = 'arcane experiment' (Kathleen's kinjirareta juma jikken, slice 054); provisional, align with that slice.

en: You routed the Board Chair.{w}
"Ngh...{w}I never imagined you had grown this strong..."{w}
note: Addressed to the party (who fought the Chair).

en: "What are you doing, Board Chair!!"{w}
"This is baD. They have comE."{w}
note: Distorted voice (see 4064). 'They' = Mirco's group, arriving in slice 058.

en: "Quite so. This will get troublesome."{w}
"...'They'? Who do you mean?"{w}
